speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that history. To better understand your condition, can you tell me if you have noticed any vaginal fluid leakage or decreased fetal movement recently? Additionally, how many weeks pregnant are you currently?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old woman, gravida 2, para 1, at 38 weeks' gestation. The patient reports experiencing vaginal bleeding for the past hour accompanied by severe abdominal pain. She mentions that she felt contractions before the onset of the bleeding, but the contractions ceased once the bleeding began. Her first childbirth was a cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Placental Abruption (suggested by vaginal bleeding, severe abdominal pain, cessation of contractions, and prior C-section). REQUEST IMAGES: Ultrasound for fetal status and assessment of retroplacental clot. REQUEST TEST: Fetal Heart Rate Monitoring, Complete Blood Count, Coagulation Profile, and Type & Screen.
